categories.main_business_segments: K.R.S. Corporation operates three main business segments: Joint Logistics (providing storage, handling, and nationwide joint delivery of food products, including bulk transport of raw materials), Dedicated Logistics (logistics center operations for convenience stores and similar clients), and Related Businesses (sales of vehicles, logistics equipment, fuel, and overseas logistics operations in China and Indonesia).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced temperature-controlled logistics technology, including four temperature zones, digital picking systems, and automated dispatch systems. It emphasizes efficient logistics network management, cold chain solutions, and IT-driven logistics information systems to ensure high-quality, reliable food logistics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are food manufacturers (notably Kewpie Group), food wholesalers, retailers (including convenience stores), and the food service industry. The company is highly focused on the food, retail, and foodservice sectors, with major clients such as Nihon Access and Kewpie Co., Ltd.
categories.geographic_coverage: K.R.S. Corporation's operations are nationwide in Japan, with significant logistics infrastructure across the country. Internationally, it has logistics operations in China (Shanghai) and Indonesia, aiming to expand its temperature-controlled logistics network across Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated logistics services (storage, handling, transportation, and information processing) between food manufacturers and end retailers or food service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening domestic logistics infrastructure, expanding into new business domains and overseas markets, and enhancing management foundations. Innovation themes focus on sustainability (decarbonization, resource circulation), logistics quality, digitalization, and human resource development. R&D is not a major cost center, but the company invests in logistics technology and system upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through logistics service fees for storage, handling, and transportation, as well as sales of logistics-related goods and equipment. Additional revenue comes from overseas logistics operations and, to a lesser extent, from leasing and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: K.R.S. Corporation is positioned as a leading food logistics provider in Japan, particularly in temperature-controlled logistics. Key competitors include other major logistics companies with food sector specialization, but K.R.S. differentiates itself through its nationwide cold chain network and strong ties to the Kewpie Group.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending November 2024, consolidated revenue was approximately 195.2 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.56 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 2.66 billion yen. The company has shown steady revenue growth (5.7% YoY), a significant recovery in profitability, and maintains a solid asset base (total assets: 130.6 billion yen).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: K.R.S. Corporation emphasizes its expertise as a pioneer in temperature-controlled logistics, offering high-quality, reliable, and comprehensive food logistics solutions. Its value proposition centers on nationwide coverage, advanced cold chain technology, and the ability to support both manufacturers and retailers with integrated, efficient logistics services tailored to the food industry.
